parts.text: I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order, and repairs and servicing are carried out by technicians like me. The platform service runs on a single server that is updated and restarted during working hours while drones are flying, and it occasionally crashes. We accept a few minutes of interruption, but I worry about the links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment being unreliable, where an instruction might get through twice and the sender cannot tell if the first attempt arrived.
